Evci et al. | ICLR 2022
This fixture summarizes a real paper about adding neurons during training.

The paper reports improved training dynamics across several vision settings.

Growing Tiny Networks: Spotting Expressivity Bottlenecks and Fixing
Them Optimally
Verbockhaven et al. | TMLR 2024
This fixture captures a real paper on growing small networks during training.
The method detects expressivity bottlenecks from backpropagation signals and
adds neurons where the current architecture cannot follow the functional gradient.
The paper reports CIFAR results that match larger models with less manual search.
